subject: Resolving Transfer to New Time Error in Wallace Ecological Modelling APP

messages.author: 19f6bac0aa8bb71d
messages.subject: Resolving Transfer to New Time Error in Wallace Ecological Modelling APP
parts:
Hello Everybody,

 

We've run into an error message when transferring to new time in our modelling process. It's limited to resolutions higher than 30 arc seconds, which can be frustrating for finer resolutions.

 

Let's discuss why this is the case and how we can fix it. Are there any technical challenges in enabling transfer to finer resolutions? Any alternative solutions or workarounds that we can try?

 

Please share your thoughts and ideas. Let's find a way to improve our modelling process.

Thank you!
